items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I got a regular commission in the sheriff's department under Elwood Hill

ctx.x: The sheriff then was Elwood Hill, and I got my new badge in 1977 and my ID -- no, I got the regular commission from Sheriff Hill and later on, the new sheriff, that lasted two or three years, Sheriff Faught -- and my new badge in '77 and ID is under Sheriff Faught. Since then, I have received my sheriff's commission.

I'm a little confused here, because I don't know what I gave -- said it as it is, I got a regular commission in the sheriff's department under Elwood Hill, and then as the sheriff's changed, the new badge, the one that I carry with me now, is from Elwood Faught, and of course, the sheriffs change after you have your new ID card.

I also carry and hold a full commission on Jefferson County, Arkansas sheriff's department, and I carry that badge. I ws saying before that I have a commission -- and it's a full commission, but it's all over now because that sheriff is gone -- Bernalillo County in the state of New Mexico, I got a full commission in Jefferson County, as I just said, and I am an honorary citizen of Pine Bluff, Arkansas -- to make that commission binding, and one last aside, and I will finish with the Odessa parties.
